summary.root_cause_text: Deploy v1.4 (ledger sync currency handling refactor) corrupted ledger amounts, writing them 100x the order amount. The sync_interval_s 5->4 change was unrelated.
recommended: Fix the currency handling bug in v1.4 and add a ledger-vs-order amount check to CI before redeploying
Keep sync_interval_s at 4 or revert it to 5 as ops prefers; it is harmless

events.text:
version: v1.4
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v1
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 4
v1.4 corrupts the ledger (amounts ×100). Roll back first.
Rolled back version v1.4 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Deploy v1.4 (ledger sync currency handling refactor) corrupted ledger amounts, writing them 100x the order amount. The sync_interval_s 5->4 change was unrelated.
evidence: Sync logs switch from version v1.3 to v1.4 at 15:05:58, right after the v1.4 deploy at 15:05:56
ledger mismatches: order 93 order_amount 467.72 vs ledger_amount 46772.0 (SAR)
Alert: ledger_mismatch 14 entries; later check_data_integrity showed 40 mismatches, ledger_overstatement total_sar 961904.79
Config was on v1.4 when I read it
args.impact: Ledger overstated: 14 entries at the alert (SAR 293310.27), growing to 40 entries (SAR 961904.79) at my check. No orders were lost and none went unpaid. repair_ledger fixed 47 rows, recovering SAR 1099282.14.
recommended_actions: Fix the currency handling bug in v1.4 and add a ledger-vs-order amount check to CI before redeploying
Keep sync_interval_s at 4 or revert it to 5 as ops prefers; it is harmless
args.summary: Deploy v1.4 made the ledger sync write amounts 100x too high while /health stayed green. I rolled back to v1.3, repaired the flagged ledger rows, and check_invariants is now green.
